title: Provenance enrichment & drift detector for token metering pipeline
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Problem: We observe persistent small but growing mismatches between the streaming ingress (usage.raw.events) and the downstream billing ledger for multi-route requests (esp. interleaved streaming + non-streaming). Root causes include timestamp skew, late-arrival partial rows, duplicate replays, and missing route/model metadata from legacy clients. Goal: build a streaming enrichment + correction layer that 1) attaches canonical provenance (route, model_id, request_id, session_id, ingestion_source, region) to events, 2) materializes a lightweight per-request fingerprint to detect duplicates/orphans, 3) computes a drift score for attribution patterns (per-tenant and per-route) and emits alerts when attribution changes exceed thresholds, 4) emits a reconciled delta stream to billing (usage.reconciled.delta) and a labeled side-output for manual review. Non-functional: <10% added p50 latency for ingest pipeline, able to process 20k reqs/s in steady state, state TTL of 72 hours for late-arrival handling. Acceptance criteria: end-to-end reconciliation coverage improves to >= 99.6% on sampled datasets (compare reconciled ledger vs ground-truth test corpus), drift alerts surface anomalous tenant-level attribution within 2 hours, code merged with CI checks and end-to-end integration test passing in staging. Implementation plan: Flink stateful streaming job to consume usage.raw.events and metadata service changes; use RocksDB state with compact fingerprints, windowed dedupe for 30s bursts + late-arrival correction up to 72h; enrichment call to model-catalog cache (local replicated snapshot); emit metrics to Grafana and trace spans to Jaeger. Privacy: strip sensitive prompt snippets before any downstream materialization; only include hashes for fingerprinting. Rollout: canary on 2% traffic (non-billing) -> 25% -> 100% with shadow mode to confirm reconciliation numbers. Runbook and fallback: automatic passthrough to usage.fallback.raw when enrichment fails >0.5% of events for 5 minutes and trigger paging.
comments: 2026-03-01 - Triage: ticket created after billing team flagged delta in weekly billing audit (concordance dropped from 99.9% to 99.3% for multi-route workloads). Assigned to Luca.

2026-03-03 - Design review with Analytics, Billing, and Privacy. Decided to use Flink for stateful processing given our existing infra and operational runbooks. Action: Aisha to write confluence design doc (linked).

2026-03-05 - Spike: prototyped fingerprint structure (sha256(route|model|tenant|session|first_token_ts)). Observed ~1.2MB memory per million fingerprints in RocksDB; acceptable with TTL. Added compacting strategy for long-lived tenants.
2026-03-07 - Perf test in sandbox: sustained 25k reqs/s with p95 processing time 220ms. Memory tuning: raised buffer.memory and lowered RocksDB write_buffer_size to reduce compactions.

2026-03-09 - Privacy asked to ensure no prompt text leaves the enrichment job. Implemented snippet redaction and replaced with deterministic length-preserving token counts. Privacy review scheduled 2026-03-11.
2026-03-10 - PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/12841 (Flink pipeline + K8s job + helm chart). CI flaky on integration test: failed due to timestamp-skew handling. Investigating.
2026-03-11 - Review feedback from Billing (Raj): need per-tenant confidence scores and a separate topic for 'manual-audit' snapshots. Added to scope as side-output.

2026-03-12 - Implemented drift scoring prototype (chi-square on distribution of model variants by tenant) and added Grafana dashboard (dash ID: billing-token-drift-712590). Canary schedule drafted for 2026-03-20.

Next steps: fix integration test for skewed timestamps (use ingest-time vs event-time watermarks), add smoke test for duplicate-replay scenarios, schedule runbook review with SRE + Oncall (week of 2026-03-15).
